['build a HuggingfaceEmbeddings module to create multimodal embeddings from text and image modalities with token, position, and segment embeddings', 'build a HuggingfaceBackend transformer backend that loads a pretrained Huggingface model and replaces layers with JIT-compatible versions', 'generate multimodal embeddings from token ids, position ids, and segment ids using the HuggingfaceEmbeddings forward pass', 'generate an extended attention mask by concatenating input masks and scaling with negative values for masked positions', 'generate encoded transformer layers by passing embeddings through the Huggingface encoder and returning last and all layer outputs']
